---
title: "The Bond Films"
---

```{python}
#| echo: false

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")
bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"].sort_values("year")

first_year = int(bond["year"].min())
last_year = int(bond["year"].max())
#| echo: true
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "James Bond Box Office Revenue Over Time"

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))
plt.plot(bond["year"], bond["revenue_musd"], marker="o", linestyle="-", color="darkblue")
plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue ($ Millions)")
plt.title("James Bond Revenue Over Time")
plt.grid(True, linestyle="--", alpha=0.5)
plt.show()
